stream: Billing engine: evidence module and typed facts
ruling: An absent settlement coverage becomes an explicit Absent observation at the meter_read boundary: assess_coverage counts it unobserved, _band_weights imputes it, one 'observed' predicate shared by both; all-None fixtures rewritten. Split statement.py along the seat's measured partition; one supply predicate; one governed-finance builder.
options_considered: require coverage on every HHRead and refuse without
consequence: UNDER_METERED has one definition and tasks 221/407 edit one predicate; the alternative made coarse-cadence runs depend on stream 6 landing first.

stream: Billing push lifecycle and unit of work
ruling: billing_run_status stays as the push ledger, written in the statement's transaction under one decision; the approve->issue gate is a state on it; the push operation moves into billing with a typed SkipReason; one unit of work owns commit/rollback.
options_considered: separate push ledger in the same transaction
fold state/refs onto the statement row
consequence: push history (retries, provider refs) stays separable from the statement of record, and a provider change never migrates the money table.

stream: Composition root per role
ruling: Per-role builders over shared engine/session/store parameters; create_app(graph); every role checks the schema head and configures logging the same way; scp-dispatch and scp-ingest compose through their builders.
options_considered: one Wired graph for every role
consequence: roles diverge only where they should; a shared collaborator is a parameter, not a graph member constructed in six processes.

stream: Control feedback as typed values and provenance by type
ruling: Emulator keeps the real multi-request Modbus sequence with pending state keyed by connection and a stated, tested one-connection-per-lane invariant; audit rows are stamped by the plane's injectable clock with device time as a separate column. AppliedSetpoint/RegisterWrite typed values; provenance required by type; contract.py's register codec split off (its partition passes heuristic 13).
consequence: field fidelity of the double is kept (the standing concern that it already diverges from a real GX), sharded dispatch must never share a connection across lanes; every time-based query over the audit log has one clock and device skew becomes observable data (task 78 rule).

stream: Ingest ack-persist ordering
ruling: Manual ack after the batch commits (aiomqtt manual_ack, bounded max_queued_incoming_messages); one ingestion pipeline module owns admit->persist->ack as a stated invariant with one flush path under one lock; consent/decode drops carried in the persisted tick by one generic conversion; pinned by a kill-the-store-mid-flush test.
options_considered: ack-on-receipt with bounded queue and counted loss
consequence: the broker's persistent session stays the system of record and the pipeline is one linear state machine an agent can read in one file; the store's unnest write is already idempotent on (device, ts, metric) so redelivery is safe; throughput is bounded by commit latency.

stream: Settlement store seam
ruling: A SettlementStore protocol beside TelemetryStore implemented by both backends and chosen at the composition root; one MetricKind policy object; SettlementCoverage carries the metric and the ops strip keys rows by it; late settlement rows append a new revision keyed by method_version with current = latest revision (append-only kept) and statement_of_record pins the revision it billed from; one parametrised contract test over both stores.
consequence: any new Metric member appears in the strip automatically; late data heals itself through one write path while billing stays replayable because the statement names its revision; the briefing's append-only decision and the hotspot's revision-ledger remedy become one mechanism.

stream: Tenant reach has one predicate
ruling: One occupancy predicate over the supply window evaluated at a time — occupant(session, home_id, at) / holds_home(customer, property, at) — used by ScopedRepository, GateConsentChecker, the optimiser identity resolver and generated RLS policy SQL; the GUC is set in the one request-session dependency with unset meaning deny and an explicit fleet marker for ADMIN/OPERATOR; pinned by a Postgres test that a connection with no GUC sees zero tenant rows.
consequence: reach matches what is billed; move-in/move-out attribution (task 323) becomes a date rule with one home; every account must state opened_on/closed_on.

stream: Board requirements without a mechanism
ruling: Not quality work: each of the 11 keys is routed to the owning capability PRD (the approve-issue, alerting and ops PRDs already filed as tasks 440-491) or to a new capability manifest where none exists; no quality stream is opened; the program doc records the routing per key.
consequence: each requirement lands with its consumer named (G1) and seams owned (G4) rather than as mechanism built from a refactor brief.

stream: Persisted vocabularies and schema equivalence
ruling: Approved as one agent-mode stream whose first leaf widens tests/test_migrations.py::test_schema_matches_orm_metadata to all 28 mapped tables with compare_type=True on both lanes; then the enum_column helper, the NOT NULL / legacy-default migration under the pre-release ruling, RecipientKind as one definition, models/__init__ registration-only, CHAIN_HEAD read from ScriptDirectory.
options_considered: approve with the schema test first
consequence: schema equivalence is enforced before vocabularies move, so every later migration in the stream is caught by the widened test.

stream: Planner boundary contracts
ruling: Fix the boundary contracts now (Forecast shape, finance as-of through billing's governed-finance builder, one outcome/skip-reason enum, per-home savepoint with one try over resolve, consent and SoC) and leave the candidate/reserve machinery for the MPC PRD.
options_considered: full rework incl. reserve and candidate factoring
consequence: MPC inherits typed inputs; candidate-specific code is deleted in one later move instead of being reworked twice.

stream: Shared frontend layer and generated wire types
ruling: TS wire types generated from app.openapi() in both SPA builds with a pytest gate asserting every TS enum union equals its Python Enum; a frontend-shared workspace package owns auth/storedSignIn/useJoinAnotherTabsSignIn, one http client with a typed failure handling 401, the one read hook (useRetryableLoad) and the formatters; RunsPanel gets a fallback tone.
options_considered: generated types vs pytest union gate
workspace package vs copied directory with byte-equality test
consequence: drift between backend enums and the console becomes impossible rather than policed; the OpenAPI document becomes a kept contract; shared concerns have one home.

stream: Validation topology as a value
ruling: Delete the dormant GitHub workflows (validation.yml, slow-lane.yml) and their 36 pinning tests; ci.cadence.LANES and the systemd timers are the one cadence home. Drills take a frozen Topology value (containers, supervisor, settings, engine). Split validation/run.py along the seat's measured partition; Verdict gains NO_SIGNAL so a lane that produced no artefact never reports PASS; container image pins in one leaf below instance/ and validation/.
consequence: nothing dormant to drift (esc-239-3 ruling: cadence = local timers); new drills compose from values and the harness lifecycle module is the one owner of the handles.

stream: Consent purpose catalogue and gate decide()
ruling: consent/purposes.py holds REQUIRED_SCOPE as the one purpose->categories catalogue; POST /consent takes purpose only and the server fills the scope from it; EXPIRED is dropped from the stored projection (0006-style migration) and the wire carries a separate effective-status type computed by one gate-side function on the injectable clock; one decide() produces CHECK_FAILED uniformly for every consumer.
options_considered: purpose-only POST vs client scope validated as superset
consequence: the catalogue is the only place scope is decided (the portal's wrong scope cannot recur); no reader can mistake the projection for liveness; renewal keys on the effective type; the briefing's 'EXPIRED is never stored' decision becomes typed.

stream: Instance render owns runtime identity and schedules
ruling: The role uid has one home: the Dockerfile creates the user with --uid 10001 --gid 10001 and creates/chowns the dispatch state directory; the render stops overriding user:; the container smoke runs as the deployed uid. One UTC-calendar/unit-text module below instance/ and ci/ that both renderers import; the render either mounts real broker/proxy configuration or stops claiming MQTTS/HTTPS.
options_considered: render constant with an image-building test
consequence: smoke and deploy run as the same identity by construction; host directory ownership instructions cite the image.

stream: Provider mode as a typed axis
ruling: A ProviderMode enum (fake, sandbox, live) resolved once from a Settings field, refused in the production deployment (ENVIRONMENT=production/prod) unless live, refused on staging when live — staging is a hardened pre-production rung that admits explicitly-set non-production modes (Leo 2026-10-16, S15 Q3, PRD §4 D6 ruling note d6ea845), turned into the port pair by the role's composition root and stamped on the run row; billing/providers/ owns the binding constructors; provider references become a typed value; one EventKind->ArrearsState map the fakes import; fakes mint their own prefixes and never echo the view's total.
consequence: one axis in the one place deployment reads; the instance render and the hermetic-switch table see it; a new mode is one enum member.

stream: Tariff as a typed domain value
ruling: One tariff constructor parses the ORM Tariff once into FlatTariff | TouTariff with minute-valued bands, a wrap flag (start > end allowed, as the domain library does) and one validity rule; the create/update routes and billing's load path both call it; the current-tariff pointer is dropped and the current tariff is derived from the open assignment as an as-of query; Tariff rates are append-only versions.
options_considered: assignment row on change with pointer cache vs drop the pointer
consequence: one band convention shared with the optimiser (Economy 7 expressible); tariff facts match the governed-ledger shape and run_billing reads only history (item 1 ruling).

stream: Wire schemas derived from one field list
ruling: Declare the value once (BatterySpec, BillBreakdown via dataclasses.fields, AccountChange) and derive ORM kwargs and pydantic request/response schemas from it; the five CRUD resources share one write mechanism; PATCH /accounts passes a typed AccountChange; every CRU write records the actor.
consequence: the domain value is the contract; storage and wire follow it and a divergence is an explicit mapping.

stream: uncontested block (9 streams)
ruling: Approved as proposed, each as an agent-mode /prd stream: Device last-seen has one reader; Time grid and UTC home; Simulated fleet identity; Dispatch composition out of control/; Settings domains and deployment profile; Governed ledgers on one mixin and reader; Money quantum and wire decimal grammar; Ops reads through public seams; Declared package strata.
consequence: one option each, confirmed findings, size S/M, low/medium risk; the remedies name what becomes deletable.

stream: invariant candidates
ruling: Each of the ten candidates lands as a checkable test inside its owning stream AND a repo-level leaf creates docs/legibility/design-invariants.md listing them in checkable form (the project had no invariants document); the program doc carries one pointer per invariant and owning stream, never a second list.
consequence: the project gains the gate-question home /prd G7 and /review phase 2 read; each invariant is enforced by a test the stream that owns the mechanism writes.

stream: weakened findings in a cell's top three
ruling: All sixteen stay in their streams at weakened weight; none is dropped and none changes a severity on its own.
consequence: the skeptic reproduced the structure in every case and marked only the weight overstated.
